scope: Browser-local experimental CAPTCHA demo. Not a production authentication boundary.

baselines.name: The eager form filler
baselines.method: Nonempty honeypot submitted to the shared checker.

baselines.name: The screenshot tourist
baselines.method: A 3.1-second-old response exceeds even the relaxed live reaction window.

baselines.name: The perfectly still genius
baselines.method: Stationary control: adequate overlap cannot compensate for no tracking movement.

baselines.name: The human-shaped control
baselines.kind: synthetic positive control — not a person
baselines.method: Generated passing aggregates validate that the checker admits a plausible input. This is not a real human trial.

limitations: Self-declared roles are not identity proof.
Baselines are deterministic local probes, not AI model evaluations.
Client-side checks are bypassable by source-aware or instrumented adversaries.
A controlled human trial and an independent AI trial have not been established by the author.
